email.subject: What's new in Lumen 4.2: offline mode and faster search
email.body:
Lumen 4.2 is rolling out to everyone this week.

What's new
• Offline mode: notes open and save without a connection, and sync when you're back online.
• Search is up to three times faster in large notebooks.
• Pin up to five notebooks to the sidebar.

Fixes
• Pasted tables keep their formatting.
• The sidebar remembers its width between sessions.

No action needed: the update installs on its own.

The Lumen team
